scene.testo: [Fernandez] among the worst of the weekend: he retired on lap 2.
[Fernandez]: twentieth in qualifying, fourteenth in the sprint and retired on lap 2. Grade *five*.
[Bagnaia]: tenth in qualifying, sixth in the sprint and thirteenth in the race, starting tenth. Today he gets *five and a half*.
[Quartararo]: eighteenth in qualifying, eleventh in the sprint and eleventh in the race, starting eighteenth. He earns *five and a half*.
[Bezzecchi]: fifth in qualifying, third in the sprint and sixth in the race. We give him *seven*.
[Alex Marquez]: first in qualifying, out in the sprint and third in the race. Grade *seven and a half*.
[Acosta]: third in qualifying, first in the sprint and second in the race. Today he gets *nine*.
And then the best: [Marc Marquez]. Second in qualifying, second in the sprint and first in the race. A performance worth applauding. Grade *nine and a half*.
